DescribeMetricCatalogs.locale: Language for returned names; accepted values: zh-cn / en-us; default: zh-cn
DescribeMetricCatalogs.scope: Cloud product identifier, retrievable via DescribeResourceCatalogs, e.g. BCE_BCC
DescribeMetricCatalogs.resourceType: Resource type identifier, retrievable via DescribeResourceCatalogs, e.g. Instance
DescribeMetricCatalogs.catalog: Top-level metric catalog name. Used to filter catalogs by name; name matching is case-insensitive
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters: List of metric attribute filter conditions. Multiple conditions are combined with AND; supports filtering by metric tags or metric dimensions
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters.key: Filter field name. Required when filters is configured; accepts a metric tag name or metric dimension name
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters.op: Filter operator; accepted values: = / != / contains / in
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters.value: Single-value filter condition, used with =, !=, or contains operators. When an empty string is used for a metric dimension, it can be used to check whether the dimension exists
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters.values: Multi-value filter condition. Required when op is in; the condition is satisfied if any one value matches
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters[].key: Filter field name. Required when filters is configured; accepts a metric tag name or metric dimension name
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters[].op: Filter operator; accepted values: = / != / contains / in
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters[].value: Single-value filter condition, used with =, !=, or contains operators. When an empty string is used for a metric dimension, it can be used to check whether the dimension exists
DescribeMetricCatalogs.filters[].values: Multi-value filter condition. Required when op is in; the condition is satisfied if any one value matches
DescribeMetricCatalogs.includingDimensions: List of metric dimensions that a metric must include all of
DescribeMetricCatalogs.excludingDimensions: List of metric dimensions where a metric must not include any of them
